market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil at $97, Fed hike risk, and trade escalation. Expect volatility in energy, defense, and rate-sensitive sectors. Consumer names under pressure from wage-inflation gap. AI upstream (memory, power) outperforms downstream. 1-3 month: choppy, risk-off bias with energy/defense as relative outperformers.

EM and China AI offer re-rating potential if geopolitical risk stabilizes. Defense spending structural. Consumer recovery contingent on wage catch-up. Fed policy path is the key swing factor—hike scenario pressures equities broadly.
